colt.d.ramsey: Zeno Ramsey unpacked a lock of hair in a matchbox at S-F17. A neighbour shifted a bag to make room without asking what it was. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Zeno Ramsey watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Otto Carlingiti and Zeno Ramsey split the last tin of beef, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.
Zeno Ramsey heard wire rattling beyond the parapet. At the change of watch, he said exactly where and asked for it to be taken seriously.
ner_small: The sergeant gave Walter Small a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 3 or any other.
Walter Small raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-F18. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Marek "Brick" Buddy of the Concord (@big_fat_buddy).
A medic checked Walter Small's dressing at S-F18 and said he would be back on his feet soon. He was already trying to stand.
